2608.22090.title: Semantic Reasoning Denoising: Correcting Language Model Reasoning with Semantic Operators
2608.22090.paper_summary: Large language models can produce fluent reasoning traces whose local semantic errors propagate to an incorrect conclusion, while unconstrained self-correction may preserve, amplify, or introduce errors. Existing diffusion language models provide iterative refinement, but usually define noise as token masking or replacement rather than as errors in the reasoning process. We present Semantic Reasoning Denoising (SRD), an operatorized Markov denoising method for natural-language reasoning trajectories. SRD represents semantic noise with executable error operators that describe the error type, its location, and the corrupted and repaired propositions. Composing these operators constructs progressively noisier states. During training, the model learns to identify the semantic noise active in the current trajectory and to reconstruct the paired adjacent lower-noise state. During inference, noise-level-aware denoising repeatedly predicts an inverse operator and checks whether it is applicable, so each executed update makes a localized move toward a stable trajectory. Across six in-domain benchmarks spanning mathematics, code, knowledge, and commonsense, SRD improves the strongest same backbone baseline by 3.2 points on average. On seven cross-dataset transfer targets, it remains competitive with Llama-3-8B-Instruct and improves the strongest Qwen3-8B baseline average by 2.9 points. Analyses of noise sources, objectives, and denoising depth further show that structured semantic-noise prediction and iterative operator execution are central to the improvement.
2608.22090.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型可以產生流暢的推理痕跡，其局部語義錯誤會傳播到不正確的結論，而不受限制的自我修正可能會保留、放大或引入錯誤。現有的擴散語言模型提供了迭代的精煉，但通常將噪聲定義為標記遮蔽或替換，而不是推理過程中的錯誤。我們提出了語義推理去噪（SRD），這是一種用於自然語言推理軌跡的運算馬可夫去噪方法。SRD用可執行的錯誤運算符來表示語義噪聲，這些運算符描述了錯誤類型、其位置以及損壞和修復的命題。組合這些運算符會構建逐漸變得更嘈雜的狀態。在訓練過程中，模型學會識別當前軌跡中活躍的語義噪聲，並重建配對的相鄰低噪聲狀態。在推理過程中，噪聲水平感知的去噪反覆預測一個逆運算符並檢查其是否適用，因此每次執行的更新都會向穩定軌跡進行局部移動。在涵蓋數學、代碼、知識和常識的六個領域基準測試中，SRD平均提高了最強同一骨幹基線3.2分。在七個跨數據集轉移目標中，它與Llama-3-8B-Instruct保持競爭力，並將最強Qwen3-8B基線平均提高了2.9分。對噪聲來源、目標和去噪深度的分析進一步顯示，結構化的語義噪聲預測和迭代運算符執行是改進的核心。
2608.22090.author: Yujiao Yang et.al.
